name: Yagami Nayuta
source:
"I don't care anymore. I'm fine being a dog!!'
Keyword: Believe

A cheerful, lively, friendly, and healthy young man. 
He has a very strong wish to be helpful towards his chosen partner and sometimes goes a little overboard.
